news.title: Bittensor’s TAO Goes Live on Robinhood Chain via Chainlink CCIP After Base Expansion
news.description: Bittensor's TAO is now live on Robinhood Chain. Forever Money built the bridge using Chainlink CCIP, giving the leading decentralized-AI token a 1:1

news.title: What the Robinhood-AMC fight over tokenized stocks is really about
news.description: The CEO of AMC ranted that Robinhood offering a tokenized version of its stock is "detestable, inexcusable, vile"—which sounds a lot like fear of a superior technology.

news.title: Robinhood CEO Defends Tokenized Stocks After AMC Criticism
news.description: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev said companies should not have veto power over tokenized stock products that do not change issuer rights or obligations.

news.title: AMC CEO challenges Robinhood’s 1:1 token backing
news.description: AMC CEO Adam Aron questioned whether Robinhood’s stock tokens remain fully backed if collateral shares are lent to short sellers.

news.title: Base tokenized stock volume reaches $100 million
news.description: Base tokenized stocks reached a $100 million daily DEX record, while Aerodrome captured 76% of the $730.9 million monthly volume.

news.title: Issuers Can't Veto Stock Tokens That Keep Rights Intact
news.description: Vlad Tenev says issuers can't block third-party stock tokens as tokenized-stock DEX volume hits $4.3B and the Robinhood-AMC feud escalates to the SEC.

news.title: Robinhood crypto trading volume jumps 61% in August
news.description: Robinhood’s August crypto volume rose 61% to $17.5 billion as Bitstamp led trading and event contracts remained far above 2025 levels.

news.title: SEC tokenized stock plan targets the register, not the token: Bitget analyst
news.description: The SEC’s transfer-agent proposal targets ownership records, as a Bitget analyst explains why tokenized stocks remain separate products.

news.title: Tokenized stocks expand access, but what do investors legally own? Tessera PE founder explains
news.description: Tessera PE founder Chan Ahn explains what tokenized-stock investors own and why legal rights, liquidity and valuation depend on structure.

news.title: HOOD Stock Gets $165 Target as Analyst Predicts Robinhood Chain Revenue to Hit $365M
news.description: Robinhood (HOOD) stock gets a $165 price target as Citizens JMP sees Robinhood Chain potentially generating $365 million in annual revenue.

news.title: Robinhood Crypto Trading Volume Jumps 61% in August
news.description: Fresh operating data shows crypto trading bouncing back, but the company's fastest-growing business these days isn't traditional trading at all.

news.title: Robinhood’s Crypto Volume Rebounds 61% in August
news.description: Robinhood reported $17.5 billion in August crypto volume, up 61% from July but down 38% year over year as Bitstamp contributed $10.1 billion.

news.title: Backed Startup Pushes Stock Tokenization Into Shopping Rewards
news.description: Crumbs, a Robinhood Chain-backed startup, is turning everyday shopping receipts into stock-token rewards, letting users earn exposure to companies they shop from.

news.title: Nasdaq invests $100 million in crypto firm, eyes 2027 launch of 'tokenized' stocks
news.description: Nasdaq is making a big bet that tokenization of stocks and other assets are becoming part of the plumbing of the stock market.

news.title: MyRacehorse brings everyday fans to the winner's circle
news.description: Micro-investing app MyRacehorse lets fans buy fractional shares of elite racehorses for an average of $463, attracting over 100,000 owners.

news.title: Ice Moves Tokenization Into Mainstream Infrastructure
news.description: ICE’s planned investment in tZERO suggests tokenization is moving into mainstream securities infrastructure, tying blockchain settlement to traditional transfer and brokerage systems.

news.title: Zoth Becomes the First Neobank to Bring Tokenized Stocks Onchain with zVaults, Opening US Equity Markets to the Global South
news.description: Zoth's vault will turn a single stablecoin deposit into diversified ownership of Coinbase tokenized US stocks on Base, with no US bank account or broker required.

news.title: TOP Financial Group Limited Announces Strategic Relocation of Global Headquarters to the United States
news.description: HOUSTON, Texas, Sept. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- TOP Financial Group Limited (NASDAQ: TOP, 'TOP” or the 'Company”), a fast-growing online brokerage firm specializing in local and foreign equities, futures, and options products, today announced the strategic relocation of its global headquarters to the United States. This transition marks a pivotal milestone in the company’s long-term growth strategy, as it gradually shifts its primary corporate focus and operational footprint to the American market. The new headquarters address is: 4201 Main Street, Suite 200, Houston, Texas 77002.

news.title: Investors argue against novel ETF label in letters to US SEC
news.description: Market participants raised concerns over the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission's proposal to label a broad ‌swathe of exchange-traded funds as "novel ETFs," according to a Reuters review of letters filed with the Wall Street regulator by asset managers, exchanges, brokerage firms, clearing houses and others.

news.title: MoneyHero Group to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Results
news.description: HONG KONG and SINGAPORE, Aug. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- MoneyHero Limited (Nasdaq: MNY) ('MoneyHero” or the 'Company”), a leading tech- and AI-powered personal finance aggregation and comparison platform and a digital insurance brokerage provider in Greater Southeast Asia, today announced that it will release its second quarter 2026 results on Friday, September 11, 2026 before market opens and will hold a related conference call to discuss the results at 8:00 a.m. EDT (or 8:00 p.m. Hong Kong / Singapore time) on the same day.

news.title: UP Fintech Holding Limited Reports Unaudited Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.description: SINGAPORE, Aug. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- UP Fintech Holding Limited (NASDAQ: TIGR) ('UP Fintech” or the 'Company”), a leading online brokerage firm focusing on global investors, today announced its unaudited financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026.

news.title: PPFAS GIFT reduces minimum investment in its two outbound passive funds to $500
news.description: PPFAS GIFT has cut the minimum investment in its S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 outbound passive funds from $5,000 to $500, effective August 25. The move aims to broaden access to global diversification for eligible Indian investors through GIFT City, offering index-linked exposure to leading US companies without requiring foreign brokerage accounts.

news.title: Futu Announces Second Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
news.description: HONG KONG, Aug. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Futu Holdings Limited ('Futu” or the 'Company”) (Nasdaq: FUTU), a leading tech-driven online brokerage and wealth management platform, today announced its unaudited financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026.

news.title: US Stock Market: Citadel Securities warns SEC rule change could hurt retail investors, market liquidity
news.description: Citadel Securities has urged the SEC to reconsider its proposal to eliminate the order protection rule, warning it could weaken market liquidity, price discovery and retail investor protections. The market maker argues the change may divert trades from public exchanges and recommends alternatives, including minimum trading-volume thresholds for exchanges to qualify for protected status.
